newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - S3 lowers in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - S3 lowers in quiet trade.

text.p: S3 Inc was one of the few stocks that was showing much movement in the after-hours trading session after the maker of software drivers released its quarterly results, traders said on Monday.
"Its the only one that is substantially different from where it closed," said one of them.
S3's stock was trading at 9-13/16 against a close of 10-11/16 on the Nasdaq.

The company reported a profit of $0.30 a share for the first quarter against $0.25 for the same period last year. But it said it foresaw operating results for the next quarter to be lower than the first due to seasonality and pricing pressure.
Centocor Inc saw its stock rise to 24-1/8 from a Nasdaq close of 23-3/4 after it reported a profit of $0.05 a share for the first quarter against a loss of $0.16 a year ago.
"Its picking up because of its earnings," said another trader.
A third dealer said the after-hours market was otherwise quiet due to the Passover holiday.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 13,800 shares against 24,400 on Friday. Session two had 707,600 shares compared to 26,700, it added.
